sloka: एवं कथयमानं तं प्रशस्य पवनात्मजम् ।सुषेणो वानरश्रेष्ठो जग्राहोत्पाट्य चौषधीम् ।। ६.१०२.३३ ।।
transliteration: evaṁ kathayamānaṁ taṁ praśasya pavanātmajam ।suṣeṇo vānaraśreṣṭho jagrāhotpāṭya cauṣadhīm ।। 6.102.33 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the mighty among the Vanaras, thinking so quickly reached the foremost of the mountains, seized the mountain with both hands by shaking it thrice, uprooted the plants with flowers in bloom and balanced it with his hands.
